name: Shopify
notes: Reads orders, products, scopes and store sessions. One write: fulfill (order fulfilled with the GLS tracking number, notify_customer false; dry run unless --confirm yes). Required scopes: read_orders, read_products, read_inventory, read_all_orders, read_reports, read_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders, write_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders. Implemented in connectors/shopify/ops.py. No customer personal data leaves the connector.
